children: Gregory N. Roberts, an insider and Chief Executive Officer, reported direct sales of Gold.com common stock on September 8–9, 2026. The filing reports weighted average sale prices of $46.864, $49.4066 and $48.9098 across the transactions. The total proceeds from the reported sales were $1,937,049. Following the transactions, Roberts directly beneficially owns 28,202 shares and indirectly beneficially owns 1,899,756 shares through related interests. The indirect holdings include 1,867,416 shares held by Silver Bow Ventures, LLC, in which the reporting person has a 50% indirect interest.

title: Gold.com Chief Executive Officer Sold Shares Worth Over $1.9M
